info.title: Waypoint Core API
info.summary: Frozen v1 contracts for attributable capture, authoritative reads, standard MCP, and defensible export
info.description: REST resources and standard MCP delegate to one authoritative application service. Core records completed outcomes and lifecycle mutations; it never executes assessment commands. Actor and engagement scope are credential-derived.

post.summary: Durably ingest one completed raw-first command capture
post.description: The envelope and both raw streams form one idempotent request. The server acknowledges only after immutable action metadata, distinct stdout/stderr evidence references, and the capture.accepted audit event commit. A replay does not create another event.

200.description: Byte-equivalent validated capture replayed; original durable acknowledgement returned

200.description: A bounded page. nextCursor is exclusive on the next request.

get.summary: Resume the authorized audit stream using persisted event IDs
get.description: SSE id equals AuditEvent.id, SSE event equals AuditEvent.type, and SSE data is the complete AuditEvent JSON. after and Last-Event-ID are exclusive and must agree when both are sent. An absent cursor starts after the connection high-water mark. Heartbeats are comments and do not advance the cursor. Slow readers are disconnected and resume by cursor.

post.description: A missing or foreign asserted action yields a pending best-effort claim; it is never silently treated as captured provenance.

actorBearer.description: A revocable per-actor credential. It is never accepted in a URL or request body.

ContractVersion.name: Waypoint-Contract-Version
ContractVersion.description: Exact negotiated contract version for this request.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Must exactly equal envelope.captureId. Scope is the credential-derived engagement and actor plus sourceAgent.id and captureId.

RequestId.name: X-Request-ID
RequestId.description: Optional caller correlation value. Invalid values are replaced, never trusted for authorization.

AfterCursor.name: after
AfterCursor.description: Exclusive persisted audit event cursor. Omit for initial REST page or a live-only stream.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Exclusive SSE resume cursor. If after is also present, values must be identical.

McpAccept.name: Accept
McpAccept.description: MCP Streamable HTTP clients advertise both response forms.

TargetFilter.name: target
TargetFilter.description: Exact target kind or value filter.

ActorFilter.name: actor
ActorFilter.description: Exact actor handle or ID filter.

ContractVersion.description: Contract version used for the response.

RequestId.description: Server-accepted or generated request correlation ID.

Problem.description: A stable machine-readable problem detail. The HTTP status and body status agree.

Retry-After.description: Present for rate or temporary capacity failures when known.
